title: CrownFall
author: Dr_Discette
selftext:
***Hi y’all, I would love to share my first true game with you.***

***Crownfall*** is a medieval city builder and real-time strategy game Inspired by some of the best RTS games of the ’90s. It’s specifically a blend of Age of empires, and the Ceasar series 

I’ve toyed with 3D modeling and game asset design for a very long time. But I’ve always struggled when it came to coding. 

The idea for this game started after I wanted to make a benchmark game for windows 98 PCs I was repairing. So I started writing out my idea and figuring out the mechanics. The game is coded in ChatGPT, with the vast majority of assets either made or converted by me into the game. 

Honestly coding the game through chat gpt is the only reason I was able to finally pull the trigger. 

I would love feedback, and maybe some tips from people who have had more time coding with AI to help optimize the game! :) 

Game is free to play with the ability to tip if you feel up to it
